note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AZ-802. Like SC-500 and AI-300, this study guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — Microsoft publishes a single undated skills list for it, and the exam is in beta. Re-check learn.microsoft.com before the exam. With seven domains this is the widest blueprint in the catalogue, so the paper is 13 / 7 / 7 / 7 / 10 / 7 / 9.
